lines: Devon, England. The morning of February 9th, 1855.
Snow lies on the villages, and people find strange tracks.
A line of hoof-shaped prints, each about four inches long.
They run in one straight line, as if on two legs.
They cross rooftops, climb walls, even pass through haystacks.
They even continue across a river two miles wide.
Reports say the trail ran up to a hundred miles.
Villagers whispered the devil himself had walked through Devon.
Theories range from badgers to an escaped kangaroo. Nobody knows.
What do you think walked there?
title: The Devil's Footprints: Tracks That Crossed Rooftops and a River #shorts
description:
In February 1855, strange hoof-shaped prints appeared in the snow across Devon, England, climbing walls and crossing a wide river. To this day nobody knows what made them.
